title: 第三章  什么？
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

孙平闻言眉头紧锁，他也不敢把公主逼得太紧。

但他实在想不通，公主平时最讨厌的就是林澈，今天是除掉林澈的最好机会，她怎么反而要保他？

难道……她不想让这个废物死？

月璇玑没再理会孙平，转身来到林澈面前。

她站在那里，居高临下看着这个狼狈不堪的男人，脸上没有半点表情，冷漠得像一尊冰雕。

“林澈，今天你犯下大错，但三年夫妻一场，我不想杀你。”

“如今，你我夫妻情分已尽，我会禀明父皇，跟你和离。”

和离...不就是离婚。

林澈愣住了。

他刚才还在心里暗暗高兴，以为公主要帮忙，以为自己终于要洗清冤屈了。

怎么突然画风一转，要跟自己和离了？

他脑子转得飞快。

如果和离，他这个镇国公庶子身份可有可无。

没了公主府的庇护，那些想杀自己的人，就跟捏死一只蚂蚁一样简单。

“我不同意！”

念及此林澈大喝一声。

月璇玑面色一寒，眼神像刀子一样锋利。

“现在，你只有两条路可选。”

“第一，和离。”

“第二，浸猪笼！”

“然后死！”

她说完这句话，便死死盯着林澈！

林澈先是一愣，便瞬间反应过来了。

这可不是生在红旗下的21世纪，而是视人命如草芥的大夏朝！

他有资格说不同意，那当然是不配！

是非在乎实力，等自己拥有滔天的权势，这些人才会正眼看自己！

也只能说月璇玑抓时机的能力太强，既不彻底得罪死镇国公府。

又能将孙平的陷害化为己用，达到甩开自己的目的，好一个一石三鸟！

她手里，明明有一本名册，能证明他是清白的。

可偏偏被她无视了.....

这下可真死无对证，林澈无奈看向月璇玑冷若冰霜的眸子！

月璇玑的表情纹丝不动，眼神却有一丝极淡极淡的复杂。

她知道林澈蒙冤，她也知道是谁在背后搞鬼，但这些都不重要。

重要的是，她得借这个机会把这桩婚事给休了。

至于林澈冤不冤？

那不重要。

至于丫鬟的死活？

那也不重要。

在京城，重要的是你是谁家的儿子，你爹是几品官，你背后站着多少人。

至于真相，那玩意儿比擦屁股的草纸还不值钱。

眼见月璇玑无动于衷，林澈无奈摇摇头。

孙平要他的命，公主趁火打劫要他的婚，这两方人马虽然各怀鬼胎，但目标出奇地一致：

踩死他这个没权没势的废物驸马。

他要是不答应和离，今天能不能活着走出后花园是个问题。

“好。”

林澈眼中闪过一抹决绝！

“我答应你。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Sun Ping frowned when he heard this, and he did not dare to push the princess too hard.

But he really couldn't figure it out. The princess usually hated Lin Che the most. Today was the best chance to get rid of Lin Che. Why did she want to protect him instead?

Could it be that...she didn't want this loser to die?

Yue Xuanji ignored Sun Ping and turned around to face Lin Che.

She stood there, looking down at the embarrassed man, with no expression on her face, as cold as an ice sculpture.

"Lin Che, you made a big mistake today, but after three years as a couple, I don't want to kill you."

"Now that the relationship between you and me as husband and wife is over, I will inform my father and make peace with you."

Reconciliation...is not divorce.

Lin Che was stunned.

He was secretly happy just now, thinking that the princess would help, thinking that he would finally be cleared of his grievances.

Why did his attitude suddenly change and he wanted to make peace with himself?

His mind was racing.

If they reconcile, his status as the prince's concubine will be irrelevant.

Without the protection of the Princess Mansion, those who want to kill him would be as easy as squeezing an ant to death.

"I don't agree!"

Thinking of this, Lin Che shouted loudly.

Yue Xuanji's face turned cold and her eyes were as sharp as knives.

"Now, you only have two options."

"First, make peace."

"Second, dip the pig cage!"

"Then die!"

After she said this, she stared at Lin Che!

Lin Che was stunned for a moment, then reacted instantly.

This is not the 21st century born under the red flag, but the Great Xia Dynasty that regards human life as nothing!

If he has the right to say he disagrees, then of course he is not worthy!

Right and wrong care about strength. Only when you have huge power will these people look at you seriously!

It can only be said that Yue Xuanji's ability to seize the opportunity is too strong, and she will not completely offend the Duke of Zhenguo.

And he was able to use Sun Ping's frame-up to his own advantage and achieve the goal of getting rid of him. Killing three birds with one stone!

She clearly had a roster in her hand that could prove his innocence.

But she just ignored it...

This time there was really no evidence, Lin Che looked helplessly into Yue Xuanji's cold eyes!

Yue Xuanji's expression remained motionless, but there was a hint of complexity in her eyes.

She knew that Lin Che had been wronged, and she also knew who was behind it, but none of that mattered.

The important thing is that she must take this opportunity to divorce the marriage.

As for whether Lin Che was wronged or not?

That's not important.

As for the life and death of the maid?

That's not important either.

In the capital, what matters is whose son you are, what rank your father is, and how many people are standing behind you.

As for the truth, that thing is worth less than the tissue paper used to wipe your butt.

Seeing that Yue Xuanji was indifferent, Lin Che shook her head helplessly.

Sun Ping wants his life, and the princess takes advantage of the situation to rob him of his marriage. Although the two parties have their own agendas, their goals are surprisingly the same:

Trample him to death, this powerless, useless consort.

If he didn't agree to make peace, whether he could walk out of the back garden alive today was a question.

"Okay."

A flash of determination flashed in Lin Che's eyes!

"I promise you."
